The '''Rynmar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] situated on the [[Rynmar Trail]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system got it's name from the planet [[Rynmar]] which was located within it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rynmar system's first and only appearance was in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' on page 136.<ref name="TEA" />
